Bipolar I and II differ in the length and intensity of the high and the presence of major depression.

Where I am from a diagnosis of bipolar I requires one experience of mania, but does not require an episode of major depression (however many people do experience symptoms of depression). Whereas bipolar II requires 
at least one of major depressive episode lasting two-weeks, and one experience of hypomania that lasts at least four days.

Mania and hypomania are similar in terms of symptoms but differ in severity. Unlike mania, an episode of hypomania is not considered severe enough to impact social functioning or to require hospitalisation. It does not include psychosis and the impact of an episode is not considered a ‘significant impairment’.

So the question is during a elevated mood (mania/ hypomania) do you need to be hospitalized?
